This is the landing page associated with the [Warwick-Stats-Resources GitHub repo](https://github.com/Warwick-Stats-Resources).

On the [resources](resources.qmd) page, you'll find details of our projects designed to make it easier to create plots, presentations and course websites consistent with the University of Warwick [brand](https://warwick.ac.uk/about/brand/).

On the [courses](courses.qmd) page, you'll find links to our latest courses.
Upcoming and in-progess courses are also listed here.

## Upcoming courses

### R Programming (March 24th-25th, 2025)

[{{< fa globe >}} website](https://warwick-stats-resources.github.io/r-programming-2025/){.btn .btn-primary}
[{{< fa brands github >}} source](https://github.com/Warwick-Stats-Resources/r-programming-2025){.btn .btn-primary}
[{{< fa user-plus >}} register](https://warwick.ac.uk/fac/sci/statistics/staff/academic-research/kaye/r-programming-2025/){.btn .btn-primary}

This is an intermediate/advanced level course. Topics covered include writing functions, error handling and debugging, classes and methods, efficient programming, profiling, C++ and Rcpp, and R tools for working with git/GitHub.
